subject.title: fix(agents): wake top-level requester when its last parallel child settles

question: Must top-level requester-settle recovery preserve its complete wave and wake obligation across process crashes before this PR can merge?
rationale: The current process-local ledger is a deliberate durability tradeoff affecting final-message delivery and restart behavior; repository policy favors durable agent-scoped runtime state, but only the lifecycle owner can confirm whether degraded crash recovery is acceptable for this contract.

options.title: Require durable recovery
options.body: Persist the minimal wave and wake obligation in the per-agent SQLite store and add a crash/restart regression before merge.

options.title: Accept process-local degradation
options.body: Explicitly approve the loss of prior delete-mode wave context across crashes and require proof that recovery still cannot lose the final user-visible synthesis.

recommendation.title: Require durable recovery
recommendation.body: Persist the minimal wave and wake obligation in the per-agent SQLite store and add a crash/restart regression before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest overlap across gateway admission, yielded-run lifecycle behavior, subagent cleanup, and the SQLite transition.
